test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
In this question, a statement and two related findings i and ii have been given. Assuming the truth of the statement, you have to consider both the findings and decide which conclusions are free of logic and logical and logical.

**Statement :**

Manish loves to read only.

**Conclusion :**

i) Manish has lots of books.

ii) In watching TV and reading the newspaper, Manish likes to read the newspaper.

Select the correct option from the options below

(A) only conclusion i logical

(B) only conclusion ii logical

(C) or conclusion i or ii logical

(D) not conclude i nor ii rational

(E) Both conclusions i and ii are rational
solution:
**Given Statement:**

Manish loves to read only.

**Conclusions:**

I. Manish has lots of books. - **Does not follow** (Just because Manish loves to read does not necessarily mean he has lots of books; he could, for instance, borrow books from a library.)

II. In watching TV and reading the newspaper, Manish likes to read the newspaper. - **Follows** (Because Manish loves to read, it can be logically concluded that given a choice between watching TV and reading the newspaper, he would prefer to read the newspaper.)

So, Only **conclusion II** is logical.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option B'**.*
